title.zh: 修订第 3179 号共和国法（授予 Victorias Milling Co., Inc. 在菲律宾境内运营私人固定点对点及陆基、陆上移动无线电台的临时许可）
title.en: An Act Amending Republic Act Numbered Thirty-One Hundred Seventy-Nine, Entitled "An Act Granting the Victorias Milling Co., Inc., a Temporary Permit to Construct, Operate and Maintain Private Fixed Point-To-Point and Land-Based and Land Mobile Radio Stations for the Reception and Transmission of Radio Communications Within the Philippines."
title.orig: An Act Amending Republic Act Numbered Thirty-One Hundred Seventy-Nine, Entitled "An Act Granting the Victorias Milling Co., Inc., a Temporary Permit to Construct, Operate and Maintain Private Fixed Point-To-Point and Land-Based and Land Mobile Radio Stations for the Reception and Transmission of Radio Communications Within the Philippines."

completenessNote: 全文，共 8 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6377_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文条号不连续（自第 1 条起，止于第 8 条，缺 6、7）：经逐条比对原始页面，该处原文没有对应的 “Section N.” 抬头行，系来源页自身的编号跳跃或条文以“续段”形式并入前条，非抽取遗漏，故未擅自补号。 源文存在同号重出的条款（第 1、3 条）：该处官方页面确有两段均标同一 Section 号，本库照录其 `no` 值（不改动官方编号），条文 `id` 以 `_2`「_3」后缀保证唯一。

text.en:
Section one of Republic Act Numbered Thirty-one hundred seventy-nine is hereby amended to read as follows:
"

There is hereby granted to the Victorias Milling Co., Inc., its successors or assigns, a temporary permit to construct, operate and maintain in Victorias, Occidental Negros and at such places in the Philippines as the said company may select, subject to the approval of the Secretary of Public Works and Communications, private fixed point-to-point and land-based and land mobile and coastal and maritime mobile radio stations for the reception and transmission of wireless messages on radiotelegraphy or radiotelephony, each station to be provided with a radio transmitting apparatus and radio receiving apparatus."

Section three of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"

The grantee, its successors or assigns, shall not engage in domestic business of telecommunications in the Philippines without further special assent of the Congress of the Philippines, it being understood that the purpose of this temporary permit is to secure to the grantee the right to construct, install, operate and maintain private fixed point-to-point and land-based and land mobile and coastal and maritime mobile radio stations in such places within the Philippines as the! interest of the trade and business of the grantee may justify."

Section eight of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"

The grantee, its successors or assigns, is authorized to operate its private fixed point-to-point and land-based and land mobile and coastal and maritime mobile radio stations in the medium frequency, high frequency and very high frequency that may be assigned to it by the Secretary of Public Works and Communications."

The title of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"An Act granting the Victorias Milling Co., inc., a temporary permit to construct, operate and maintain private fixed point-to-point and land-based and land mobile and coastal and maritime mobile radio stations for the reception and transmission of radio communications within the Philippines."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive Approval, August 16, 1971.
